goal: Let a user move to a higher plan with a clear price difference and explicit confirmation of the new recurring charge.

steps.title: Choose your plan
steps.description: Selectable plan cards; the current plan is marked as text, not color alone.

success.title: You're on Pro!
success.message: Your upgrade is active immediately. The receipt is in your inbox.

errors.message: We could not charge your saved card.
errors.recovery: Offer to update the payment method without losing the chosen plan.
